methodology.current_builder: Every WynnBuilder link was loaded in a fresh Playwright page. Beta links were redirected to the official site and every old-version migration prompt was accepted.
methodology.tree_acceptance: No rendered ATree error, AP cost at or below cap, and at least 80% of AP retained. The AP threshold is a configurable completeness proxy, not a legality rule.
methodology.solver_acceptance: Current tree acceptance plus level 100 or higher, current local decode, complete noncrafted equipment, matching class, and feasible skill points at median displayed ID rolls.
